lesson_title: Who Eats Whom in the Pilanesberg
hook_text: A cheetah, a zebra, a baboon and a dung beetle. Which one is the most important?
clip_script: Game drive in the Pilanesberg. Grass and trees make food: producers. Zebra and impala eat plants: herbivores. The cheetah eats impala: carnivore. Baboons eat fruit and insects: omnivores. Join all the chains and you get a food web. And at the end? Vultures clean up, while fungi, bacteria and dung beetles break it all down and return nutrients to the soil. Everything is recycled!
visual_style: Whiteboard food web building up from grass at the bottom to cheetahs at the top, with a dung beetle and mushrooms feeding arrows back to the soil.
mood: Wild and exciting, like a safari.
pacing: One animal at a time, then the web snaps together, then the recyclers.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw a food web for your own garden.
